work: 邢雲路《古今律曆考》卷四十五，第二表
method: Download public PDFs, verify source SHA-256, extract each original embedded image stream, decode to RGB without resizing, inspect manually without OCR or arithmetic emendation. Crop coordinates are valid on the decoded stream, right and bottom exclusive. Hashes cover row-major RGB pixel bytes. Page numbers refer to digital spreads.

erratum.reason: On NLC08938 p14 the adjacent glyphs after 九 are 七、七, followed by 五、三 before the cell boundary. The previously recorded 13UV image stream hash matches the reacquired source.

erratum.prior_1608_scope: NCL06272 L132 疾 agrees with NLC08938 glyphs, and L132 遲 retains its printed 七五二 versus NLC08938 七五三. Its L35 疾 full terminal glyph is unawarded in 13VE; no digits are filled here.

conditional_replay.inherited_model: 13UV artificial integer scaling and floor(8200000000 / r). The ancient radix, carry, rounding and extension from 遲 to 疾 remain open.
conditional_replay.impact: The old L35 疾 residual -161 becomes +59 and the hypothetical hidden divisor interval moves from around 11755.7 to around 11752. The updated interval still misses both display bins at 11753 (integer truncation and nearest integer). The same residual occurs in L132 遲 under this assumed model. The two low-rate rows print unequal coefficients for the same compact rate, so one function of printed rate alone cannot reproduce both under identical assumed encoding.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: Cross-surrogate glyph differences do not establish block independence, a single lineage or which impression is authorial.
NLC08938 equality for one reversed-lane pair does not imply symmetry for all rows or validate table-field equivalence to G893.
unresolved_lineage_questions: How do the NLC08938 and Tianjin impressions relate to the catalogue-bound Xu An 1600 NCL06270 copy?

next_action: Seek authenticated NCL06270 original L35/L132 images through a public or verified-free route, compare the two positions without filling glyphs from other copies, and seek explicit 疾捷法 construction and 少/微 radix/carry instructions in source-original context.
